name: player_update_master_type_basic_or_track_from_modal_probe
description: Player::UpdateMasterTypeBasicOrTrack_FromModalProbe samples modal probe heights, copies the modal yaw-rate limit, reduces active probe sample heights to the maximum, zeroes pitch and roll, and applies the modal altitude transition offset to worldPos.y.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this wrapper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player modal-probe/master-type source-cluster pass.
